name: Single's Inferno: Choices
storyline: You and your fellow participants will sleep, cook and compete in challenges at the bare-bones Inferno beach camp. But you'll have chances to match with a romantic prospect and be whisked off for a night in Paradise — a luxurious resort where you'll share a suite (and swap secrets) with your potential sweetie.
summary: Experience your own romance in the emotional pressure cooker of "Single's Inferno,". In this choice-driven game, you and a group of other highly eligible contestants live and look for love on a remote tropical island, where your decisions shape the story.
